summary: Use runtime dispatch for Iterator.prototype.flatMap when the callback cannot be statically lowered with canonical function-call semantics.

target.notes: Runtime reuses the generic JavaScript [[Call]]/Proxy callability semantics owned by FUNCTIONS while preserving the Iterator helper protocol, close behavior, callback argument order, and arbitrary thrown values.

semantics.callback_dispatch: generic JavaScript call semantics, including callable Proxy when applicable
semantics.iterator_protocol: same as paired helper fast-path rule
semantics.abrupt_callback: preserve iterator close and thrown-value semantics

caveats: Do not model a dynamic callback with a plain C# delegate or dynamic invocation; Proxy apply traps and JavaScript callability are observable.
